name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }} on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version:
          - 26
          - 24
          - 22
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - run: npm install --legacy-peer-deps
      - run: npm run test:js
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
      - run: npm install --legacy-peer-deps
      - run: npm run lint
  run-rules-on-codebase:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
      - run: npm install --legacy-peer-deps
      - run: npm run run-rules-on-codebase
  integration:
    name: Integration test (${{ matrix.group }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        group:
          - "1"
          - "2"
          - "3"
          - "4"
          - "5"
          - "7"
          - "8"
    env:
      TIMING: 1
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
      - run: npm install --legacy-peer-deps
      - run: npm run integration -- --group ${{ matrix.group }}

name: Title formatter

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, edited]
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  Rule:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          sparse-checkout: docs/rules
      - name: Auto-format rule names in titles
        uses: fregante/keyword-formatter-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          keywords-path: docs/rules
          prefix: unicorn/

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Every night at midnight UTC, for new App Store data and releases.

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    # Xcode 27 is the default Xcode on this image.
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      changed: ${{ steps.compare.outputs.changed }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # The full history gives the sitemap the date each page last changed.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Swift version
        run: swift --version
      - uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          # The build, the package checkouts with the prebuilt swift-syntax, and the App Store and GitHub responses, which are revalidated with ETags.
          path: |
            .build
            .cache/responses
          key: build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('Package.resolved') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('Package.resolved') }}-
      - name: Check browser script syntax
        run: |
          for file in public/scripts/*.js public/apps/*/*.js; do
            node --check "$file"
          done
      # Debug, like the tests, so one build serves both. A release build takes 8–10 s longer to compile on CI and saves only about 1 s when building the site. Keep it debug.
      - name: Build
        run: swift build --build-tests -Xswiftc -Xfrontend -Xswiftc -warn-long-expression-type-checking=200
      - name: Test
        run: swift test --skip-build
      - name: Build site
        env:
          # Authenticated requests have a much higher GitHub API rate limit.
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: swift run --skip-build website build
      # A deploy is skipped when the site is the same as the published one. The related apps rotate daily, so the nightly build changes the app pages once a day.
      - name: Compare with the published site
        id: compare
        run: |
          hash="$(cd dist && find . -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256 | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
          echo "$hash" > dist/build-hash.txt
          published="$(curl --fail --silent --location https://sindresorhus.com/build-hash.txt || true)"
          if [ "$hash" = "$published" ]; then
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && steps.compare.outputs.changed == 'true'
        with:
          path: dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.build.outputs.changed == 'true'
    concurrency:
      group: pages
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
      # Cloudflare caches the HTML (see the readme), so the cache is purged after a deploy. Skipped when the secrets are not set.
      - name: Purge the Cloudflare cache
        if: env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' && env.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID != ''
        run: |
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --request POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/purge_cache" \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
            --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data '{"purge_everything":true}'

    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version:
          - 24
          - 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm test

name: CI
on:
  - push
  - pull_request
jobs:
  test:
    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version:
          - 20
          - 18
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm test
